title: IAMM
tagline: IAMM [ImpAct Meta-Market] serves as a foundational platform for the entire NFT ecosystem and provides opportunities for many markets to emerge.
description:
IAMM [ImpAct Meta-Market] serves as a foundational platform for the entire NFT ecosystem and provides opportunities for many markets to emerge. By default, NFTs created on IAMM are composable, fractional and extensible, which in essence they become their own Meta-Market, but what is possible with these is up to the users. 
On IAMM builders can create NFT templates, for example, that game designers can easily use for tokenized in-game items. Or they could create an NFT extension that creators can use to add access-controls to their NFTs.
They could even create an extension that other extension developers can use to introduce new payment models for the use of their technology/creation.
Libre NFTs is our philosophy to give the creators, developers, collectors and curators the freedom to generate value and get rewards for the value generated.
IAMM Libre NFTs is a platform to allow creators to create impact metamarkets.
We enable a crypto economic model that rewards participation, and we enable the use of an Identity layer to allow creators to feel the freedom of the web3.
how_its_made:
We are using the following Smart Contract Standards:
ERC4907, ERC1155, ERC721
We use the following technologies:
- Polygon
- Super Fluid
- GNosis Safe
- IPFS
- Unity
- Hardhat

We have different components like:
- A Minting Layer, where the users can upload their NFTs and start their journey.
- An Identity Layer, that allows the users to explorer different features safely.
- A Rewards model, to motivate participation.
- A Communication Layer, to allow interaction of the communities around NFTs
